items.q: How do you separate dissolved salt from water?
items.correct: Evaporate the water, leaving the salt behind.
items.misconception: Filter the solution to remove the salt.
items.why: Filtration only removes insoluble solids; dissolved salt is recovered by evaporation/crystallisation.

items.q: In distillation, what happens to the liquid that evaporates?
items.correct: It is condensed back to a liquid and collected — not destroyed.
items.misconception: It is used up and disappears.
items.random_wrong: It is filtered out as a solid.
items.why: Distillation evaporates then condenses a liquid to purify or separate it by boiling point.
